205: // Return the real index and step values for a slice when applied to a sequence of
206: // the given length, resolving missing components, negative values and values off
207: // the end of the sequence.
208: void mp_obj_slice_indices(mp_obj_t self_in, mp_int_t length, mp_bound_slice_t *result) {
209:     mp_obj_slice_t *self = MP_OBJ_TO_PTR(self_in);
210:     mp_int_t start, stop, step;
211:     mp_slice_zero_runtime_bounds();
212:     mp_slice_zero_runtime_list();
213:     mp_slice_zero_runtime_array();
214:     mp_slice_zero_runtime_pixel();
215:     mp_slice_note_seq_kind(0, length);
216: 
217:     if (self->step == mp_const_none) {
218:         step = 1;
219:     } else {
220:         step = mp_obj_get_int(self->step);
221:         if (step == 0) {
222:             mp_raise_ValueError(MP_ERROR_TEXT("slice step can't be zero"));
223:         }
224:     }
225: 
226:     if (mp_slice_sign_int(step) > 0) {
227:         // Positive step
228:         if (self->start == mp_const_none) {
229:             start = 0;
230:         } else {
231:             start = mp_obj_get_int(self->start);
232:             if (start < 0) {
233:                 start += length;
234:             }
235:             start = mp_slice_min_int(length, mp_slice_max_int(start, 0));
236:         }
237: 
238:         if (self->stop == mp_const_none) {
239:             stop = length;
240:         } else {
241:             stop = mp_obj_get_int(self->stop);
242:             if (stop < 0) {
243:                 stop += length;
244:             }
245:             stop = mp_slice_min_int(length, mp_slice_max_int(stop, 0));
246:         }
247:     } else {
248:         // Negative step
249:         if (self->start == mp_const_none) {
250:             start = length - 1;
251:         } else {
252:             start = mp_obj_get_int(self->start);
253:             if (start < 0) {
254:                 start += length;
255:             }
256:             start = mp_slice_min_int(length - 1, mp_slice_max_int(start, -1));
257:         }
258: 
259:         if (self->stop == mp_const_none) {
260:             stop = -1;
261:         } else {
262:             stop = mp_obj_get_int(self->stop);
263:             if (stop < 0) {
264:                 stop += length;
265:             }
266:             stop = mp_slice_min_int(length - 1, mp_slice_max_int(stop, -1));
267:         }
268:     }
269: 
270:     mp_slice_assign_bound_result(result, start, stop, step);
271:     slice_runtime.bound_length = length;
272:     slice_runtime.bound_start = start;
273:     slice_runtime.bound_stop = stop;
274:     slice_runtime.bound_step = step;
275:     slice_runtime.extract_pos = start;
276:     slice_runtime.extract_count = mp_slice_window_len(start, stop, step);
277: }
